title: Notification regarding Full Court Farewell in honour of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Kempaiah Somashekar , the Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Dated the 10th September, 2025
There will be a Full Court Farewell in honour of Hon’ble Mr. Justice Kempaiah
Somashekar, the Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur, at 11:30 a.m. on Friday, the
12th September, 2025 at Court Room No. 1.
BEFORE
HON’BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE KEMPAIAH SOMASHEKAR
HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE A. BIb40L SINGH
AND
HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE A. GUNESHWAR SHARMA
FROM THE LEGAL FRATERNITY
1. Mr. Lenin Hijam, Advocate General, ManiF)ur.

3. Mr. Naorem Kumarjit Singh, President, High Court Bar AssoCiation of Manipur.
4. Mr. Chakpram Bimolchandra Singh, President, All Manipur Bar Association.
5. Mr. Khomdram Sarnarjit Singh, Deputy Solicitor General of India,
ON BEHALF OF THE HON’BLE JUDGES
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Birnol Singh
Reply By:
Hon’ble The Chief Justice Mr. Kempaiah Somashekar
